title: feat(mode): implement Ralph mode for infinite task loops
author: dannycreations
lessons: Infinite loop features need hard cost/token ceilings independent of loop count limits
setTimeout is not a lifecycle tool -- use event emitters or promise chains for task sequencing
Refactoring shared control flow for a new feature changes behavior for all users, not just feature users
Tests must include all methods the implementation adds to mocked objects
Author self-reporting 'still working on it' is a clear signal the PR is not merge-ready

test_results.notes: No CI checks on feat-ralph-mode branch. Tests likely fail due to mock issues.

critical_issues: No cost/token ceiling for unlimited loops -- runaway API spend risk
Race condition: setTimeout(1s) restart after abortTask() can hit disposed provider
Tests would fail: mock objects missing handleRalphRestart, abortTask; state missing alwaysAllowRalph
handleMistakeLimitReached changes mistake-limit behavior for ALL users, not just Ralph users
